label: Coconut value-chain products
about: Virgin coconut oil, desiccated coconut, coconut sugar from neera, and shell charcoal from the Pollachi coconut belt, where farmers sell whole nuts and copra cheap and price swings hit them hardest.

questions.ask: Which coconut products do you want to start with?
Retail bottles and pouches, or bulk bags for food companies and exporters?
Will you process in your own unit, or use a contract processor at first?
How many kilograms a month do you expect to sell in the first year?

formats.bulk_bag: Bulk bags for food companies and exporters

coconut_nuts.label: Mature de-husked coconuts
coconut_nuts.sourcing: Farmers and FPOs around Pollachi and Udumalpet; about 2 nuts a kg; prices follow the copra market, so agree a band or index the price to it

coconut_nuts_dc.label: Mature coconuts for desiccated coconut
coconut_nuts_dc.sourcing: Same farmers; uniform mature nuts give whiter, higher-yield desiccated coconut

neera.label: Fresh neera (coconut sap)
neera.sourcing: Licensed neera tappers or a farmer producer company; neera ferments within hours unless chilled at collection

coconut_shell.label: Coconut shells
coconut_shell.sourcing: Oil mills and desiccated-coconut units in the Pollachi belt; buy dry shells by the tonne

recipe_note: Starting yields for trials, not tested processes: about 6.5 kg of nuts per kg of virgin coconut oil, 4 kg per kg of desiccated coconut, 7 litres of neera per kg of sugar, 3.5 kg of shell per kg of charcoal. Measure your own; yield decides your cost.

costing_defaults.format_lever: Sell the side products: coconut water and milk residue from oil, shells to charcoal makers
costing_defaults.label: Example figures for a first estimate. Replace with your own quotes; nothing here is a market price.

regulatory.title: FSSAI registration or licence by turnover
regulatory.text: Basic registration up to ₹12 lakh annual turnover; State licence above that (up to ₹20 crore); Central licence above. Apply on FoSCoS.

regulatory.title: Legal Metrology declarations
regulatory.text: Pre-packed goods carry name and address, net quantity, MRP, date and customer-care details.

regulatory.title: AGMARK grading for coconut oil (voluntary)
regulatory.text: AGMARK certification is voluntary for coconut oil, but many institutional buyers ask for it.

regulatory.title: Neera tapping and sale licence
regulatory.text: Tapping and selling neera in Tamil Nadu is licensed, with conditions to keep it from fermenting into toddy. Confirm the current rules with the state before tapping.

regulatory.title: Pollution consent for charcoal kilns
regulatory.text: Charcoal kilns emit smoke and need consent from the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board; closed kilns with smoke recovery are easier to approve.

regulatory.title: Coconut Development Board for exports
regulatory.text: Exporters of coconut products register with the Coconut Development Board, which also runs processing-unit support schemes.

templates.title: Choose the coconut products and their buyers
deliverables: Which are foods, which are neera products, which are shell products
Who buys: households, bakeries and food companies, exporters, industry
templates.why: Each product needs different equipment, licences and buyers.

templates.title: Secure nuts, neera or shells
deliverables: Agreements with farmers or an FPO around Pollachi
Price band, or a price indexed to the copra market

deliverables.text: Neera collection with chilling at the tree or within hours
Shell supply contracts with oil mills and desiccated-coconut units

templates.why: Raw material is most of your cost, and coconut prices swing with the copra market.

templates.title: Process trials and measured yield
deliverables: Yield per kg of raw material for each product

deliverables.text: Oil method chosen (cold or hot process) and oil quality checked: moisture, free fatty acids, smell
Neera boiling trials: sugar colour, moisture and taste
Kiln trials: charcoal yield and fixed-carbon content

templates.why: Yield decides cost more than any other number; measure it before you price.

templates.title: Samples and prices with buyers
deliverables: Price and volume they would commit to
templates.why: Food companies and exporters buy on specifications; retail buys on taste and price.

templates.title: Cost every kg using your measured yield
deliverables: Cost sheet per product with your yield and quotes
Side products priced in (coconut water, residue, shells)
templates.why: Side products often decide whether the main product makes money.

templates.title: Licences, tests and labels

deliverables.text: FSSAI {fssai_tier}, lab tests at an NABL-accredited lab, and food labels
Neera licence confirmed with the state
Coconut Development Board registration for exports

templates.why: Each product line has its own licence; none can be sold before it.

templates.title: Pilot batch with a contract processor
deliverables: Processor with the right licence for your product
Quality checks against your trial targets

applies.label: you start with a contract processor

templates.why: Low fixed cost while volumes are small.

templates.title: Set up a small processing unit
deliverables: Premises meeting the rules for your products
Equipment: grater, press or centrifuge and filters for oil; dryer and grinder for desiccated coconut; evaporator for sugar; kiln for charcoal
Ask about Coconut Development Board processing support before buying equipment

applies.label: you process in your own unit

templates.why: Higher fixed cost; pays off above the break-even volume in your cost sheet.
